g.text: Descriptive structural context: primary distributions and eight published networks
Original primary cohort only: 896 attempts; 890 valid graphs; 6 terminal failures.
Primary CSV only: valid defined graphs, 50 nodes; four fixed models and seven instruction conditions pooled by method.
Boxes: median/IQR; whiskers: 1.5 IQR; small dots: graphs; diamonds: named references, 31-70 nodes. Tailor waves are not independent.
Different tie definitions and sizes; missing metrics stay missing. No CIs or tests; not a realism benchmark or winner ranking.
